For କୁନି ଗଣେଶ (Kuni Ganesha), a report on the planned television series names Shreyas Sahil, then a primary-school pupil, as the character’s voice. Jyotiranjan Swain wrote and directed the series, with music by Rajesh Shankar. [children-kuni-voice] A child was helping give the animated figure its voice. The television reading follows the wider animation work; here it brings another kind of collaboration beside the live-action films and translated versions.
